# kcore_volumes (Data Source)

List volumes. Set `vm` to list only the volumes attached to one VM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kcore_volumes" "web" {
  vm = "web-01"
}

output "web_volumes" {
  value = [for v in data.kcore_volumes.web.volumes : v.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
